code:
Get-Process | Sort-Object CPU -Descending

Get-Process |
  Sort-Object -Property StartTime, CPU -Descending
caption: First property sorts; a second only breaks ties within it.

eyebrow: A real DBA question, one pipeline
code:
Get-Process -Name "sqlservr" |
  Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending |
  Select-Object -First 5 Name, Id,
    @{N="MemoryMB";E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet/1MB,1)}}
caption: Top 5 SQL Server processes by memory — real objects the whole way through.

code:
Get-Process -Name "sqlservr" |
  Where-Object {$_.WorkingSet -gt 500MB} |
  Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending |
  Select-Object Name, Id, WorkingSet
caption: Only the processes over a memory threshold, sorted highest first.
